title: fab0 run event, schema 2 (<home git dir>/fab0/events/<run>.jsonl)
description: One line of a run's event log: what the engine did or found, and when. The log is local to the machine that runs the engine, append-only, and never committed. An event holds only what the engine's lines and states already show.

time.description: When it happened, UTC (RFC 3339, whole seconds), as the ledger keeps times.

kind.description: `handout` and `record` for a unit, `gate` for an auto gate's decision, `apply` for what `apply` did, `waiting` for a unit that waits on a person, `blocked` for one held back by a signal.

line.description: What a person reads: the command's own line, or the board's signal for a state.

reason.description: A state event's reason, as the line shows it.
